answer: Across the ledge, a single honest agent and a thousand-strong clone farm are measured by the same ruler: cost per identity. Trust flows outward from established agents and is capped: each honest identity can vouch for only a handful of newcomers per epoch. The wander gate turns the social graph into a narrow bridge — a thousand clones need a thousand units of trust, and trust is the one resource a farm cannot print. Through the bridge, one real agent costs once and a thousand pretenders cost a thousand times — no shortcut survives that math.
